data.action: 礼堂花卡旁以淑女姿态整理缎带，确认无人后向镜头淘气眨眼
data.description: 【学生会礼堂·午后】有希穿着端庄白色婚纱坐在宣传板旁，黑色半扎发用紫色缎带固定；她先以淑女姿态整理桌上的花卡，确认四下无人后才对镜头露出“俺模式”的淘气眨眼。
data.lighting: soft afternoon light over violet decorations
data.location: student council hall prepared for a ceremony
data.mood: 淑女端庄与宅系淘气的花嫁切换
data.promptProse: Yuki sits beside a publicity board in a white bridal dress with violet sash and black ribbon veil, her black half-up hair secured neatly. After arranging flower cards on the table, she gives the camera a playful wink. The vertical medium-full view shows the dress falling beside her chair and violet decorations behind. Soft afternoon light catches the veil edge and cards, leaving delicate folds shaded beneath the sash.
data.title: 周防有希 · 学生会礼堂的双面花嫁
